result.title: Decomposing images in a PRISM: A Single-Source Multi-View Framework for Image Representation
result.summary: Multi-view learning has shown that combining complementary views can improve predictive performance, yet many datasets provide a single raw source of information. How can multiple useful views be constructed from one source? We propose PRISM (Plural Representations of Images via Structural Maps), a framework that transforms an image into representations with distinct inductive biases through explicit structural maps, together with a protocol for measuring what each view contributes. We evaluate PRISM-HD, a hand-designed instantiation of PRISM in which the constructed views are summarized through representation-specific descriptors, on three artistic and four non-artistic image datasets. Analyses at a fixed feature budget show that the gains of the structural views are not explained by feature dimensionality alone. PRISM-HD by itself outperforms WND-CHARM on all seven datasets. Moreover, PRISM-HD and Fisher Vector provide complementary predictive signals: their equal-weight combination improves over the better individual representation by 5--8 percentage points on the artistic datasets. When combined with fine-tuned deep networks through a fixed parameter-free fusion rule, the PRISM-based representation improves performance on four of seven datasets and leaves it statistically unchanged on the remaining three, indicating that the constructed views provide predictive signals that are complementary to learned deep representations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PRISM 框架，通过显式结构映射把单一图像源转换为多个具有不同归纳偏置的视图表示，并给出度量各视图贡献的协议；其手工实例 PRISM-HD 在七个艺术与非艺术图像数据集上与经典描述子、微调深度网络组合评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 「单源构造多种异质表示并量化各视图贡献」可能为多 latent 假设的多样性设计与贡献分配提供类比线索，但该工作是静态分类特征，未涉及推理期状态更新或答案对 latent 内容的使用，需核查其贡献度量是否能迁移。
